title: The MCP tool descriptions leave out what an agent needs to read panes and scratch.open
body:
The descriptions of decade's MCP tools in `src/server/mcp.rs` leave out facts an agent needs and can only guess at. An agent in a decade workspace listed them in a report. Each fact below already holds in the code or in `docs/protocol.md`.

| What the agent could not tell | What is true |
|---|---|
| What `client: null` in `panes` means | No program in the pane has said hello on decade's socket. A terminal or GUI app may still run there. |
| Why every `shows` list was empty | ghostty and coax declare no kinds, so only a decade-aware program such as decade-code fills `shows`. |
| Where `scratch.open` with `terminal: false` puts the program | decade puts the first window of the program, or of a process under it, in the scratch pane. |
| The working directory and `PATH` of a program `scratch.open` starts | The workspace directory and decade's own `PATH` (`Children::command` in `src/server/children.rs`). |

## Proposal

Each fact goes, in a sentence, into the description of the tool it concerns: the first two in `panes`, the last two in `scratch.open`. The server instructions stay as they are, except for any line that contradicts the new text.

## Cost

Text only. No version moves.
